newsitem.title: UK: Rugby union-Inga the pin-up calendar hunk!.
newsitem.headline: Rugby union-Inga the pin-up calendar hunk!.

text.p: LONDON, Nov 26 - Former All Black and Wasps centre Va'aiga Tuigamala makes his debut as a pin-up hunk in a 1997 celebrity calendar to raise funds for the British Red Cross, NZPA reports.
Inga is captured wearing a dark three-piece suit in a wild-eyed, mid-haka pose for the month of March.
Photographer Bob Carlos Clarke called taking Inga's picture a "spine-chilling experience".
"We asked him to perform the haka war dance... He was so loud a neighbour came around to see if we were all okay," Clarke said.

The calendar also features Mick Jagger's estranged wife, model Jerry Hall, and Jade, Jagger's daughter with Bianca Jagger. Rock musician Bryan Ferry, Keanu Reeves' new woman Amanda de Cadenet and violinist Vanessa Mae also feature.
The Red Cross hopes to raise stg 30,000 ($NZ71,123) from sales of the calendar which retails for stg 15.
